_readme: SYNTHETIC test reviews written by the developer assistant to exercise the detector. They are NOT real Amazon or Flipkart reviews, are not tied to any real product, and must never be shown to users as real reviews. 'label' is the pattern each text was written to follow (genuine_pattern = specific, personal usage detail; suspicious_pattern = generic, repetitive, promotional or contact-spam wording). Because the same author wrote the rules and these examples, results on this file measure whether the detector behaves as designed, NOT how accurate it is on real reviews.
